A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fried Wild Greens are made by [[Cooking]] at least one herb, [[Flower]], or [[Vegetable]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The regular version can be made by using [[Hyrule Herb]]s. Eating one will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. These dishes are known to be basic, their recipe being to sauté fresh wild plants. Based on the [[Ingredient]]s used, several different variations of Fried Wild Greens can be made: * '''Hearty Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Fried Wild Greens}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hearty Radish]]es or [[Big Hearty Radish]]es. When eaten, they will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum number of Hearts. * '''Enduring Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Fried Wild Greens}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Endura Carrot]]s. If these Greens are consumed, they will completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Fried Wild Greens}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Swift Carrot]]s or [[Swift Violet]]s. Eating them will increase Link's movement speed temporarily. * '''Spicy Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Fried Wild Greens}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Warm Safflina]]s. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Fried Wild Greens}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Electric Safflina]]s. Link will be granted one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when one of these is eaten. * '''Mighty Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Fried Wild Greens}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Thistle]]s. Eating one will temporarily increase Link's attack power. * '''Tough Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Fried Wild Greens}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Armoranth]]s or [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s. They temporarily increase Link's [[Defense]] when consumed. * '''Sneaky Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Fried Wild Greens}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Blue Nightshade]]s or [[Silent Princess]]es. When eaten, they will increase Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period of time. * '''Chilly Fried Wild Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Fried Wild Greens}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A basic vegetable dish made by sautéing fresh wild plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Cool Safflina]]s. If they are eaten, they will increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Fried Wild Greens return in {{TotK}}. With the addition of [[Stambulb]]s, it is now possible to make Energizing Fried Wild Greens, which was impossible in {{BotW}}. Two new variations of Fried Wild Greens can also be made. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Copious Fried Wild Greens * Food * Meal * Salt-Grilled Greens }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
